method: Directional search discovery followed by official service-page verification. Priority is an editorial judgment based on overlap with our buyer and offer, not a traffic or market-share ranking. No connected GA4, GSC or paid keyword dataset was available.

competitors.name: Belkins
competitors.summary: Managed appointment setting with custom retainers and several channel packages.
competitors.reason: User-named competitor; close overlap with qualified meetings and managed cold email. First comparison.
competitors.intent: Belkins alternatives; Belkins alternative; Belkins vs The Revenue Inbox

competitors.name: SalesHive
competitors.summary: Managed SDR programs spanning phone-only and phone-plus-email coverage.
competitors.reason: Useful comparison for buyers deciding between an SDR team and an email-led meeting service.

competitors.name: Martal Group
competitors.summary: Tiered outsourced services, from lead generation to onboarding and account management.
competitors.reason: Compare appointment generation with a broader outsourced sales function.
competitors.intent: Martal Group alternatives; Martal Group pricing

competitors.name: CIENCE
competitors.summary: Managed outbound SDR, cold email, calling and wider GTM services.
competitors.reason: Relevant managed-services competitor; distinguish CIENCE services from the related graph8 platform.

competitors.name: Cleverly
competitors.summary: Managed B2B outreach across LinkedIn, cold email and cold calling.
competitors.reason: Close channel overlap. Verify each service package separately; do not apply LinkedIn pricing to email.
competitors.intent: Cleverly alternatives; Cleverly cold email pricing

competitors.name: SalesRoads
competitors.summary: Appointment setting and outsourced SDR services using calling, email and list building.
competitors.reason: A useful phone-and-SDR comparison, with a different delivery model from our core offer.

competitors.name: Sopro
competitors.summary: Fully managed multi-channel prospecting with enquiries delivered to the client's sales team.
competitors.reason: Distinguish sales enquiries from our billable qualified booked meetings.

competitors.name: SalesBread
competitors.summary: Personalized LinkedIn and email outreach with a published sales-qualified-lead offer.
competitors.reason: Close boutique-agency overlap; confirm what qualifies as a lead before comparing guarantees.

competitors.name: Sales.co
competitors.summary: Done-for-you outbound, including email and broader account-focused multi-channel programs.
competitors.reason: Direct email-led alternative; assess paid scope and outcome definitions, not only entry fees.

competitors.name: Leadium
competitors.summary: Appointment setting with email, cold calling, LinkedIn and data sourcing services.
competitors.reason: Relevant outsourced SDR alternative; validate buyer demand before allocating a full page.

competitors.name: Callbox
competitors.summary: B2B lead generation and appointment setting positioned around enterprise and international markets.
competitors.reason: Include for larger, multi-market buyers; less direct fit for our lean-founder audience.

watchlist.name: LeadBird
watchlist.status: Official site returned no readable content in this research pass. Verify service and pricing before prioritizing or publishing claims.

excluded_categories: Self-serve sending platforms such as Instantly and Smartlead
Data and prospecting software such as Apollo and Clay
Unrelated inbound-only or consumer lead-generation agencies
data_needed: GA4 last 90 days: session source/medium, landing page and booking conversions
GSC last 90 days: query and page exports, including branded competitor searches
CRM or sales notes: agencies prospects evaluated and won/lost reasons
A connected keyword provider for location-specific demand estimates; no volumes inferred from search results
